title: Rainy day ideas
intro: Wet weather can be a good reason for a short break. Pick one idea and leave the rest.

prompts.text: Stand by a window and watch how the rain runs down the glass.
Listen to the rain for a full minute without doing anything else.
Make a warm drink and hold the cup in both hands for a moment.
Find a spot where you can see the sky, and look at the shades of grey.
If you have an umbrella, step outside for a few minutes of fresh, damp air.
Look for puddles or drips and notice how the surface ripples.
Fill a glass of water and take your time drinking it.
Walk to the far end of the building and back, listening for rain.
Notice what the damp air smells like when you open a door or window.
Wipe your desk or screen with a cloth and enjoy a tidy surface.
Check where the coats and umbrellas are, and tidy them if they have slipped.
Ask someone how their day is going, or send a friendly note.

backAtDesk: Back at your desk. Warm and dry, and ready when you are.
